findings: A click shows the panels of its context 2 frames after the injection in all 480 steady clicks (8 for an End turn: the seven frames of the job and one for the HUD to catch up); the frames are recorded and the oracle fixes only a ceiling (10 and 40)

The end of a turn runs one phase in each of seven frames, in the order of the service, publishes a snapshot in each and turn_ended once in the frame of the last phase, in all 120 steady turns (128 with the warm-up); the ids of the 128 jobs rise by one

The native views, the SceneTree's nodes and Godot's node monitor are the same every time a context comes back (none 14, tile 18, warrior 24, dialog 24, stack 26, settler 27, city 42; the tree holds 10 more), with 0 orphans in all 546 readings

The live heap at rest of each of the 17 series grows 128 bytes between the medians of the halves (limit 2,048), flat to the byte from round 9; its ramp in the first rounds ends where the HUD's bounded lists (64 entries) fill

The resident memory fell 57,8 MB between the medians of the halves (the OS compressed the process at round 22), against a limit on a rise of 48 MiB; its pace between the falls (0.5 to 0.6 MB a round) is that of Godot's static memory, the probe's own readings
The headless frame intervals of the turn are 6.7 to 7.4 ms in every phase, the unpaced loop's own floor, and say nothing about a presented frame; the host's pump over the turn is 24 ms of the 45
No JavaScript error and no promise rejection went unhandled, the host and the HUD reported none, and the control after the run (one rejection that nobody handles) was seen once
The windowed lane was not presented by the display: three attempts rejected as unpaced, no frame-time statistic, exit 3

decisions.note: this slice records and proposes no bound: the freeze (congelado) is a later, single act; the HUD measured is the one on main at the pinned commit, which V05-05 is still changing

limitations: Headless and synthetic: the clicks are events pushed through the viewport on the validation device, with no hardware pointer, touch screen, iPhone or mobile export; the durations are the CPU cost of work on a loop that nothing paces and are not frame times
The frame time of a presented window (vsync on, 120 Hz) is PENDING, and so is the windowed part of the baseline; no budget row starts from this slice
One machine shared with other agents (the load average is recorded around every process); only the differences that held across runs are conclusions
The HUD is V05-05's work in progress and the tour is one fixed path through turns 1 to 5 of one scenario; it is not an economy that keeps growing or a long session
The two frames from the click to the panels are an observation and an explanation that fits the structure; the pumps were not traced inside the frames
The host reports its pump and JS, mount and layout phases as running totals and the last 128 samples of each series, not per frame
The heap rule is blind to what the warm-up has not finished (the bounded lists fill for about six rounds) and the resident-memory rule is a coarse trend, blind to a leak under about 3 MiB a round
